description: This file implements a common fault handler for ARCv2 processors in the Zephyr RTOS, including functions for stack overflow detection, exception dumping, and fatal error handling.

methods.name: z_check_thread_stack_fail
methods.description: Checks if a memory fault is due to a stack overflow by examining the fault address, stack pointer, and thread's guard region.

methods.name: get_protv_access_err
methods.description: Returns a string describing the type of access error based on a parameter value.

methods.name: dump_protv_exception
methods.description: Dumps details of a protection violation exception based on cause and parameter.

methods.name: dump_machine_check_exception
methods.description: Dumps details of a machine check exception based on cause and parameter.

methods.name: dump_privilege_exception
methods.description: Dumps details of a privilege violation exception based on cause and parameter.

methods.name: dump_exception_info
methods.description: Provides detailed dump of exception info based on vector, cause, and parameter.

methods.name: _Fault
methods.description: Main fault handler invoked on fatal hardware errors, reports error details, and triggers system fatal error handling.
